title: AcmeDB CLI Reference
body_text:
# AcmeDB CLI Reference

  The `acme` CLI manages instances, databases, and runs SQL.

  ## acme db create

  ```
acme db create mydb --owner admin@example.com --size 10GB
```

  Creates a new database owned by the given user. Available sizes: `1GB`, `10GB`, `100GB`.

  ## acme sql

  ```
acme sql mydb "SELECT count(*) FROM users;"
```

  Runs a read-only query and prints results as a table.

  ## acme admin logs

  ```
acme admin logs my-cluster --tail 100 --follow
```

  Streams the last 100 log lines; use `--follow` to tail live.

title: AcmeDB Documentation
body_text:
# AcmeDB Documentation

  AcmeDB is a distributed SQL database built for modern, globally distributed applications. It offers strong consistency, automatic sharding, and a PostgreSQL-compatible wire protocol.

  
    Installation
    Query Syntax
    CLI Reference
    Troubleshooting
  
  ## Key concepts

  An instance is a logical cluster of database nodes. An instance owns one or more databases. Databases contain schemas, which contain tables. Connections are made with `acme://HOST:5432/dbname`.

title: Troubleshooting
body_text:
# Troubleshooting

  ## Connection refused on port 5432

  Ensure the container is running (`docker ps`). If it exited, run `acme admin restart my-cluster` and check the logs.

  ## Error PIT-123: quorum lost

  This occurs when a majority of nodes are unavailable. Restart the affected node with `acme admin restart node-` and verify recovery via `acme admin logs --follow`.

  ## Slow queries

  Add an index with `CREATE INDEX ON events(ts)`. Inspect plans with `EXPLAIN ANALYZE ...`.

title: Query Syntax
body_text:
# Query Syntax

  AcmeDB supports a PostgreSQL-compatible SQL dialect. All statements are transactional.

  ## Selecting rows

  ```
SELECT name, balance FROM accounts WHERE balance > 1000 ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 10;
```

  Filtering uses standard `WHERE` with `AND`/`OR`. Predicate pushdown is automatic across shards.

  ## Joins

  Inner, left, and right joins are supported. Cross-shard joins incur a network round-trip per participant shard.

title: Installing AcmeDB
body_text:
# Installing AcmeDB

  ## Prerequisites

  AcmeDB runs on Linux x86_64 hosts with at least 4 GB RAM. Docker is supported for local development.

  ## Docker install (quickstart)

  ```
docker run -d -p 5432:5432 --name acmedb \
  acme/acmedb:latest --auth root:secretpw
```

  The server starts in ~5 seconds and listens on port `5432`. The default superuser is `root`.

  ## acmectl CLI

  Install the CLI with: `curl get.acme.dev/cli | sh`. Then run `acmectl cluster create my-cluster --size m5.large` to provision a managed instance.
